blocks.text: A fiber or cable provider runs two operations at once. One is the network: lines, OLTs, sign-ins and home routers. The other is the business: plans, invoices, collections and care.

With Alepo **ISP software**, your network and your business run as one, through **ISP management software** that runs from sign-up to suspension. A plan sold in the morning is active on the line the same morning, and a missed payment restricts the session until a payment restores it, with no visit and no call.
Each product also works on its own. Many providers start with one, usually the AAA server or Fulfilment Manager, and add the rest over time.
